run_text_regression_training: run an autotrain text regression model training job with specified project name and data path
register_text_regression_subcommand: register the text-regression subcommand parser with training deployment and inference arguments
create_text_regression_command: create a RunAutoTrainTextRegressionCommand instance from parsed command line arguments
validate_text_regression_args: validate required arguments like project name data path and model for text regression training
build_text_regression_project: build an AutoTrainProject with TextRegressionParams and create a training job on the specified backend
